review.scope: Four original still anchors viewed in full and with orientation-corrected native-pixel inspection crops. Labels describe visible signs only; no whole-clip truth is asserted.

limitations: Manual governing-road labels are assistant judgments; independent human adjudication remains absent.
Sign-post bases are occluded in all four anchors. Geometry-only inference must abstain rather than substitute sign centres as ground points.
The 15:43 still does not verify a readable 70 or the physical identity of the prior live detection.
Still and live-frame captures are separate. Candidate-time links are hypotheses only and never transfer boxes or truth.
Symbolic directed connections illustrate possible context; they are not OSM corrections or rebuilt bundle topology.
All four anchors come from the development drive; none is an independent held-out case.
One isolated view per sign cannot support a physical tracking gain.
Ground anchors and road polygons are manual observations, not an implemented lane/geometry model.
The 50 is a different physical sign from the 30 repeated in the next two frames.
Equirectangular fixed-x positions are not comparable with a mounted phone camera; never score the legacy x threshold on these frames.
No legitimate mainline speed sign is visible in the selected approach; this subset cannot establish mainline recall.
Two-second still cadence is preserved; no frame duplication or invented vehicle speed/deceleration.
Geographic novelty is audited only against available repository manifests and drive corpora; overlap with upstream classifier training cannot be ruled out.
Current OSM references are a dated topology counterfactual and do not prove 2025 sign applicability.
Public host fallback: IGN items were discovered through the Panoramax federation because OSM France storage was unreachable.
Four non-ego observations cover two physical exit signs; these are not four independent sign encounters.
One real on-ramp observation is a legitimate-sign positive control; no cross-year physical identity is asserted.
Cadence is unusable for temporal tracking. Microsecond source timestamps are preserved without fabrication.
Current OSM topology and lane tags postdate capture; use as explicitly labeled counterfactual context only.
Legacy native map/fix diagnostics are unavailable for public images, so a native guard baseline is not observed.
Manual supplementary-arrow-to-road annotations are retained for review but excluded from the geometry-only experiment because they already contain a road relation.
Two geographic areas and four public capture sequences; repeated frames and opposing directions at one exit are not independent route samples.

limitations: Manually reviewed image geometry: an attribution upper-bound experiment, not learned-model accuracy.
Fixed-x baseline is a simplified counterfactual on still-image boxes, not native live replay.
Expected labels are separate from the geometry assignment and used only for scoring.
No behavior features or learned lane estimates run; no incremental benefit is claimed for them.
Manually supplied arrow-to-road relations are retained as annotations and never used as inferred predictions.
Verified tracks may reuse only past assignments within 2500 ms in sequences explicitly marked as genuine cadence; sparse stills do not create confirmations.
Original timestamp strings and microsecond ordering are preserved; normalized or unknown cadence disables temporal carry.
Image-space road proximity is not a metric 3-D estimate or proof of legal applicability.
Raw equirectangular panoramas have no comparable fixed-x baseline; projection groups are reported separately.
Small manually reviewed corpus cannot establish field accuracy, mobile latency, or deployment readiness.
